annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a European Parliament and Council Directive on the approximation of the laws of the Member States relating to measures against the emission of gaseous and particulate pollutants from internal combustion engines to be installed in non-road mobile machinery
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a European Parliament and Council Directive on the approximation of the laws of the Member States relating to measures against the emission of gaseous and particulate pollutants from internal combustion engines to be installed in non-road mobile machinery
annotation.summary_en: 1995 European Commission proposal for a directive setting two-stage emission limits and an EC type-approval scheme for diesel engines in non-road mobile machinery such as excavators and forklifts. It is not about AI or robotics. It covers engine families, conformity of production and aligns with US rules.
key_provisions_or_claims: Two-stage emission limits (Stage I 1997-98, Stage II 2001-03) for CO, HC, NOx and particulates
EC type-approval with engine families and parent-engine testing
Manufacturer marking, reporting and conformity-of-production controls
Exemptions for armed forces engines and end-of-series stock
Tax incentives allowed under conditions; Annexes adaptable via committee procedure
